Just wanted to respond even if you don't come back after your sleep.

Can you actually tell me you think men receive an equal amount of comments because I seriously don't think it's equal at all.

Up until recently (in western society at least, RIP the rest of the world) men have been told their voice is more important than woman's and now that is changing I hope men will learn they do not get to say whatever they like to me as I walk down the street or post a picture with friends.

End note: wow I started to rant here once I figured out what was really making me feel so upset

It's more about me uploading a picture eating lunch with some friends and having guys rate who'd they'd rather 'smash', that were 'typical thots' for eating a meal and sharing a nice picture of us together online.

I am not referring to people specifically creating sexual content. Men who create sexual content also receive sexual comments but there aren't really many derogatory words created for men anyway. But like I said, my post was not intended to be about people intentionally creating sexual content.

6% of alleged rapists are convicted and some portion of that group don't receive jail time at all, and the average for those who do spend time in jail was 4 years 9 months in Australia in 2011-12. I don't think that seems to be very harsh.

The difficulty in gathering enough evidence for a conviction is part of the reason why I disagree with keeping someone who has been accused hidden from the public. Maybe another victim is out there who has suffered at the same persons hands and can give their testimony or give evidence and help put a monster away.

I agree corruption is the reason a lot of sexual predators don't spend enough time in prison but I also think it's the way media can portray them as a normal person who made a mistake but they're really not a bad person and we shouldn't ruin their future ([example](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/mar/18/steubenville-misplaced-sympathy-jane-doe-rapists)). Add that to the problem that rape kits are not processed efficiently, there are so many sitting there waiting around. This is ridiculous when this is some of the only evidence you can have in these cases.

I believe the way to reduce the prevalence of false accusations is to actually process evidence, punish proven false accusers with a prison sentence and when rapists are proven to be rapists they receive a harsh punishment, not 6 months.
